title: Review (Weak): on fresh seed 7 evoloop reproduces 35 generations and a founder-kind replacement through births (side 11 -> 4 at t~55k -> 3 at t~150k); the variation-off control holds; the 4 -> 3 step is not explained by birth rate and there is no neutral twin
summary: labkit on seed 7 (300^2, 20k steps, K=3 frames): 234 persistent splits, max generation 35, merge/split 0.39. c16's loop genealogy on seed 7 (400^2, 200k steps): 184,031 births with a parent; the side-11 founders' kind is replaced by side 4 at t~55k and side 4 by side 3 at t~150k (267/272 loops at t=200k; tracker/kinds_s7.png). Kinds breed true (side 3 0.87, side 4 0.75, side 11 0.71); side 3 gains 57,268 on-kind births against 2,982 conversions of living side-4 loops, so the sweep runs through births and deaths (conversions per off-kind birth 0.12). Small kinds breed 2.4x faster per loop-time than the founders (4.7-4.8 vs 2.0 per 1000 loop-steps), but sides 3 and 4 breed at the same rate (4.74 vs 4.77) and side 4 leaves more offspring per death (1.34 vs 1.03). SDSR control on seed 7 (side-8 founders, no evolution rules): side 4 holds 288/298 loops at 100k with near-sterile variants (0.03-0.21 offspring each); Evoloop from the same founders keeps side 4 for 100k (209/215).

observations.D: rerun/seed7/FACTS.md: 234 persistent splits, max generation 35, merge/split 0.39
observations.H: tracker/kinds_s7.png and tracker/demography_s7.json: side 11 -> 4 -> 3 by on-kind births (side 3: 57,268 births vs 2,982 conversions), breed-true 0.71-0.87, small kinds 2.4x faster than the founders' kind; SDSR (variation off) holds side 4 at 288/298 for 100k steps (tracker/census_sdsr8_s7.json)

seeds_run.result: pass: generations, true breeding and the founder-kind replacement through births reproduce; second sweep (4 -> 3) not explained by birth rate

controls_run.H: tracker/census_sdsr8_s7.json (the claim's variation-off control, SDSR rule, seed 7) and tracker/census_evo8_s7.json (Evoloop, same side-8 founders)

verdicts.limitation: Weak because the rubric's neutral arm is missing: SDSR removes variation, it does not replay the same events without fitness effects, so a drift explanation for the 4 -> 3 step (equal birth rates, fewer offspring per death for side 3) is not excluded; the 11 -> 4 step does follow a 2.4x birth-rate advantage. Conversions per off-kind birth were 0.12 here vs 0.05-0.09 claimed. One fresh seed; B not checked.
